issues.rule: Nothing appears before its event / marks pushed when event becomes visible (checks.json: amount_before_event x2)
issues.saw: For the second event (`settled`, orderId `ord_99b70e93-7b65-4edd-a97f-8464c86f2b0d`), the caption ('Gemini agent asked for 1.5 USDC') and the yellow packet label ('asked 1.5 USDC') display the amount '1.5 USDC' at 00:13, and the coin label ('1.5 USDC 0xd026fed3') appears at 00:19, both before the `settled` mark is recorded at 00:24.
issues.expected: No label or element containing the event's amount (`1.5 USDC`) or receipt (`0xd026fed3`) may appear in the snapshot before the event's mark time `t`, OR the `settled` event mark must be pushed when the event's sequence begins (or the preliminary request packet/caption should not include the amount before the settlement mark).
issues.fix: Either push the `settled` event mark at the start of the event beat (when the first label/element for that event becomes visible), or omit the amount `1.5 USDC` from the pre-settlement request packet label and caption so that `1.5 USDC` only appears at or after the `settled` mark timestamp.

issues.rule: Style: Paper background with consistent visual hierarchy
issues.saw: At 00:02, the wooden stage platform suddenly turns solid black and stays black for the rest of the video.
issues.expected: The stage platform should keep its consistent warm wood/paper tone throughout the animation instead of turning black when the first event starts.
issues.fix: Do not overwrite the stage platform material color or lighting when the replay loop updates after t=2s.

issues.saw: From 00:22 to 00:35, the red coin label ('1.5 USDC 0xd026fed3...') above the Merchant overlaps the blue refusal label ('refused rule_payto...') above the Basis Theory vault, and also slightly overlaps the ledger label at 00:25.
issues.expected: Floating labels above adjacent stations (Vault, Merchant, Chain) must not overlap each other.
issues.fix: Offset the vertical positions (Y/top CSS coordinate) or horizontal anchoring of the vault refusal label, the merchant coin label, and the chain ledger label so their bounding boxes have clear separation at 1280x720.
